# Fixtures for `geojson` (GeoJSON)

Files made for whiff's tests for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour), CC0-1.0 unless the table says otherwise. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/geo.sh`.

|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-harbour.geojson` | ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON (GDAL 3.10; RFC 7946, and the 2008 crs member) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-utm.geojson` | ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON (GDAL 3.10; RFC 7946, and the 2008 crs member) | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbours.geojson` | Written for whiff's test suite (formerly a JSON fixture) | CC0-1.0 |
